verdict.rationale: Typesense claims native LLM integrations for built-in RAG and Natural Language Search (docs-42, docs-41, docs-17), which can generate AI answers over the user's indexed data. However, the evidence shows only brief marketing mentions, framed as developer-facing search APIs rather than an in-product insights or suggestions experience. Missing for 10: in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions about the data, detailed docs on how the RAG/conversational feature works, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
